dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You might need to prepare a boat armed with a cannon.

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: Oh, is that how it is? I get it, then!

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: Huh... You're such a nice person...

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: Looks like I still have a lot more to prepare. I wish I could go to Liyue across the sea or perhaps Mondstadt, even further away, sometime soon...

dialogues.speaker: Yuzu
dialogues.text: I've heard that the people in Mondstadt are carefree and live as they please. When will I be able to experience something like that...
